behaviors_asserted: Context exposes a sendEvents() method that opens a Server-Sent Events connection and keeps it open until closed (e.g., on client disconnect).
The object returned by sendEvents() supports dispatchMessage(message) to send data to the client via SSE.

The object returned by sendEvents() emits a 'close' event that can be listened to (e.g., target.addEventListener('close', ...)) when the client disconnects, allowing cleanup (such as calling unwatch()).
